description: Defines a template class 'base_resumable_procedure' for resumable tasks that are not coroutines, including methods for async control flow, and a type alias 'async_procedure' for non-coroutine resumable tasks.

classes.name: base_resumable_procedure
classes.description: Template class for resumable tasks that are not coroutines, providing async control flow mechanisms.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Resumes or starts the resumable procedure based on coroutine frame state.

methods.name: async_await
methods.description: Handles awaiting an Awaitable object within the resumable procedure.

methods.name: async_return
methods.description: Completes the async task with a void result.

methods.name: async_return
methods.description: Completes the async task with a non-void result.

methods.name: final_await
methods.description: Handles final suspension and cleanup of the coroutine frame.

methods.name: await_resume_helper
methods.description: Processes the result of an Awaitable when it returns a value.

methods.name: await_resume_helper
methods.description: Processes the result of an Awaitable when it returns void.
